question_text: Explain why a surveyor may compress a large set of image files before archiving and sending them.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Compression reduces their encoded size, allowing more files in the same storage capacity. At the same network bit rate, fewer bits require less transmission time.

marking_points.criterion: Reduced transfer time at fixed bit rate.
